program: Wingless raw-input to invariant representation to zero-shot multi-step reasoning chain
question: Can a completely task-untrained third raw surface family use only context-induced representations plus transition knowledge learned from two other families to execute unseen multi-step role programs?
hypothesis: Using the qualified R5 repaired three-family bridge, the learner will recover twenty-seven surface motifs and nine correct three-member alias classes. A class-transition model trained only on families 0 and 1 single-step task records will then achieve at least 0.95 exact final-state accuracy on all 192 frozen family-2-only three-, five-, and seven-step programs, including conjugated right-role transformations, while exact-surface and shuffled-family2 controls remain at or below 0.25.

portfolio_context.allocation: 75% chain / 25% substrate falsification over eight completed post-shift experiments

prior_evidence.observation: R5 recovered all 27 motifs and nine correct three-family classes; family 2 had zero task-training records yet scored 1.0 on all 80 one-step tasks. Exact-surface scored 0.0625 with 80 missing keys and shuffled context scored 0.05.

scope_statement: This is a bounded zero-shot multi-step transfer test. Passing establishes composition of learned transition knowledge through a completely task-untrained raw surface family on the frozen synthetic role workload; it does not establish open-domain reasoning.
authority: research-only; no deployment, external-model inference, scheduler, queue, accepted-ref, production, broker, or live-interface authority

representation_and_training.bridge: byte-identical R5 repaired normal bridge: three families, nine entities, thirty-two distinct context keys per entity, 864 records
representation_and_training.surface_representation: R5 top-27 raw four-byte window selector
representation_and_training.shuffled_control: R5 family2 value +3 mod 4 and operation +1 mod 5 context assignment
representation_and_training.task_training: families 0 and 1 only; all five operations x sixteen ordered value pairs x twenty repeats per family
representation_and_training.transition_state: induced operation class plus ordered induced value-class pair -> observed output-class pair counts

heldout_programs.input_values: both raw input value motifs are family 2
heldout_programs.operation_aliases: every operation step uses the family-2 raw operation motif
heldout_programs.conjugated_right: for every ordered semantic value pair and left-swap start 0..3, execute swap_roles -> left_swap_start_k -> swap_roles
heldout_programs.long_program_generation: for every ordered semantic value pair and four frozen seeds per length, use the established deterministic role-program generator from WLM-LM-RAW-REP-ROLE-COMPOSITION-R1

learners.induced: R5 normal classes plus class-transition model trained only on families 0 and 1; predicted class-state is fed into the next operation step
learners.exact_surface_control: exact surface transition model trained only on families 0 and 1; family-2 exact transition misses use the frozen lowest-surface-pair tie behavior and predicted surface state feeds forward
learners.shuffled_bridge_control: R5 frozen shuffled family2 classes plus the identical class-transition training and feed-forward execution

controls: Family 2 contributes raw bridge observations only; it contributes zero task-transition training examples.
No multi-step program appears in task training.
Every heldout input value and operation surface is from family 2.
Prediction code never calls evaluator operation semantics; evaluator semantics generate and score targets only.
Predictions, not targets, feed forward through every step for all learners.
No tokenizer, external model, network access, capacity growth, oracle correction, or post-result tuning is permitted.
validity_criteria: Exact parent, North Star, and sealed R5 evidence identity match.
Bridge construction, surface selection, normal classes, shuffled family2 assignment, and task-training corpus are byte-identical to R5.
Exactly 192 heldout programs execute and every program has at least three operations.
Every heldout raw input value and every operation motif is family 2.
All learners feed their own predictions into subsequent steps.
Evaluator operation semantics and semantic mappings are inaccessible to prediction.
All metrics are finite and full Go regression passes before the probe.
No tokenizer, external model, network call, capacity growth, threshold change, or adaptive evaluation occurs.

classification_rules.supported: All validity criteria and all twenty-five frozen thresholds pass.
classification_rules.mixed: Validity passes and induced zero-shot multi-step accuracy materially exceeds both controls, but at least one 0.95 accuracy threshold fails.
classification_rules.negative: Validity passes but induced multi-step execution does not materially outperform exact-surface or shuffled controls.
classification_rules.incomplete: Compute interruption prevents the full 192-program matrix.
classification_rules.invalid: Any family-2 task leakage, bridge drift, feed-forward violation, evaluator-boundary violation, deterministic-state, or qualification criterion fails.

stop_conditions: Stop invalid before science on parent, North Star, R5-reuse, build, or frozen-package drift.
After output begins, complete all 192 programs across all three learners unless infrastructure prevents it.
Do not add family-2 task examples, alter bridge contexts, change program generation, increase capacity, or weaken thresholds after observing output.
no_post_result_tuning_rule: No training corpus, bridge, representation, class induction, program, learner, control, metric, threshold, or interpretation may change after primary output.
